data.name: Dadil
data.gender_notes: Dadil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-d-l' which means 'soft, gentle, mild'. In Islamic tradition, the name Dadil symbolizes kindness, compassion, and a gentle nature. The name Dadil carries the meaning “Gentle, soft, kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dadil usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, soft, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Dadil is believed to be a reflection of the divine grace and nourishment that comes from the natural world. It is a reminder of the importance of appreciating the gifts of nature and the role they play in our lives.
data.etymology: Dadil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, soft, kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dadil total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
